Nearest City: Harrisonburg, VA
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: CHLORINE
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
TOWN EMPLOYEE WAS CALLED OUT TO CHECK A WATER LEAK. WHEN HE RAISED THE GARAGE DOOR TO THE MAINTENANCE SHOP, HE SMELLED A STRONG ODOR OF CHLORINE GAS. HIS BROTHER WAS WITH HIM AND HE CALLED THE TOWN MANAGER WHO IMMEDIATELY CAME TO THE SCENE. A DECISION WAS MADE TO CALL 911. ALSO THE FIRE DEPT AND RESCUE SQUAD WERE CALLED TO COME TO THE LOCATION. THE EMPLOYEE WAS CHECKED OUT AND TAKEN TO THE LOCAL HOSPITAL AND RELEASED. THE FIRE COMPANY SENT TWO MEN INTO THE BUILDING WERE THEY DISCOVERED A 150 LB. CYLINDER OF CHLORINE GAS WAS LEAKING. THE HAZMAT TEAM WAS CALLED TO THE LOCATION AND THEY WENT INTO THE BUILDING AND CAPPED OFF THE CHLORINE CYLINDER.
